caption_instagram:
Signing a rent agreement for more than a year? Read this first. 🏠

📝 A lease of more than one year must be registered (Registration Act, 1908, s.17)
💰 Pay the correct stamp duty for your state — an unstamped agreement can't be used as evidence until duty and penalty are paid
🧾 Pay rent digitally or get signed receipts — keep proof of every payment
📂 Keep a signed copy of the agreement and the deposit receipt

caption_linkedin:
Rent agreements are among the most common documents people sign — and among the most often done informally. Three points for tenants and landlords:

• Registration: under Section 17 of the Registration Act, 1908, a lease of immovable property for more than one year must be registered. This is why many residential agreements are drafted for 11 months.
• Stamp duty: the agreement must carry the stamp duty prescribed by your state. Under the Indian Stamp Act, an unstamped or under-stamped document cannot be admitted in evidence until the duty and penalty are paid.
• Records: pay rent through traceable channels or collect signed receipts, and keep copies of the agreement and the security deposit receipt.
